- For the normalization kernel, since CH_PER_G=32 is tiny, process many groups per program (e.g. 32 groups = 1024 channels) using one warp per group via 2D tiles, and apply Welford-free two-pass within registers — this maximizes occupancy on the 1024-row launch.
